bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 $230 和 200 日均线

read.en: Bloom Energy fell 8.7% on Oct 22 to $217.77, trading between $210.74 and $229.91 on 1.7 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($225.3), 10-day ($240.8), 30-day ($264.7) and 100-day ($249.4) averages and just under the rising 200-day ($218.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and below zero, histogram little changed; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($257.64), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月22日下跌 8.7%，收于 $217.77，盘中区间 $210.74–229.91，成交量为平均水平的 1.7 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$225.3）、10 日（$240.8）、30 日（$264.7）和 100 日均线（$249.4）下方，并略低于上行的 200 日均线（$218.9）。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图变化不大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$257.64），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The drop gave back the $230 June pivot and slipped under the 200-day; the low undercut the $213.1 Oct 20 low but the close held above it. Resistance is $218.9 (200-day), then $225–230 (5-day, June pivot) and $240.8 (10-day). Support is $210.7–213.1, then $197.5 (Sep 1 low) and $185.9 (Aug 24 low). A close back above the 200-day would target $225–230; below $210.7, $197.5.
read.zh: 股价失守 $230 的 6 月转折位并跌破 200 日均线；盘中低点跌破 10月20日低点 $213.1，但收盘守在其上方。阻力为 $218.9（200 日均线），其次 $225–230（5 日均线、6 月转折位）和 $240.8（10 日均线）。支撑为 $210.7–213.1，其次 $197.5（9月1日低点）和 $185.9（8月24日低点）。若收盘重回 200 日均线上方，下一目标看 $225–230；若跌破 $210.7，看 $197.5。
